description.value:
This shotgun's extreme firepower pulverizes everything in its path. Faultless as far as murder weapons go.

Category: Very Expensive • Fabrication: DV24 - 1,000eb - 2 Weeks

Class: Iconic EQ Shotgun • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: N/A

Damage: N/A • Capacity: 2 (Shell Only) • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Shotgun Shell (4d6)

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Power Rebuild, Shotgun Rechamber • Mods: None

Special Features: Incompatible with Capacity modifying Attachments. Can only load custom Armor-Piercing Shotgun Shells (100eb [Premium] per 10 shells) that, whenever they would ablate armor, ablate 1 additional point of SP (2 Total). When firing this weapon, the user may choose to expend an additional round. When done, this weapon deals 2d6 additional damage (6d6) but sets the user Mildly on Fire (2 HP damage a Turn) for the next 9 seconds (3 Rounds). While this weapon’s user is On Fire due to this weapon’s effects, their MOVE is increased by 2 to a maximum of 8. When rolling for damage with this weapon, 5s count as 6s for the purposes of incurring a Critical Injury.

Fabrication: DV24 - 1,000eb - 2 Weeks
Range: N/A
Pre-installed: Power Rebuild, Shotgun Rechamber (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Shotgun Shell (4d6)

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).
  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Very Expensive benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
